theme.rationale: Security Operations Center (SOC) environments require dark mode to reduce eye strain during extended monitoring. Deep grays with high-contrast semantic colors (Red/Amber/Green) ensure immediate threat recognition.

typography.strategy: Chivo provides an authoritative, technical feel for headings. Inter offers maximum legibility for dense data. JetBrains Mono is critical for logs, IPs, risk scores, and metrics.

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted for SOC Dark Mode)
colors.rules: Never use pure black. Use zinc scale. Reserve red exclusively for critical alerts and high risk scores. Apply border-collapse and subtle borders.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use border-collapse for dashboards. Items have subtle borders on right/bottom. Flat backgrounds, no shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. For sticky headers, use backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/70 border-b border-zinc-800.
visual_enhancers.motion: Minimalistic. Hover states should slightly lighten backgrounds. Important alerts can use a subtle pulse animation on the left border.

grids_layouts.spacing_system: Tight for dashboards (p-4, gap-4). Generous for settings (p-8).
grids_layouts.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4. Top KPI metrics span 2 or 3 cols. Main charts span 6-8 cols.
grids_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense tabular data. Right-align numerical metrics and risk scores.

components.modifications: Remove rounded-xl from Shadcn Cards, change to rounded-none or rounded-sm. Use sharp edges for a technical feel. Use Badge components with varying opacities for risk levels (e.g., bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 border border-red-500/20).
components.charts: Use Recharts. Use dark-mode friendly tooltips. No grids, just X/Y axes for cleaner look. Use primary_accent, critical_red, high_amber for chart lines/bars.
components.toast: Use Sonner for toast notifications, located at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js
components.icons: Use lucide-react. Standardize size to 16px for inline data, 24px for metrics.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Use text-zinc-100 for primary text, text-zinc-400 for secondary.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-logs-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize a true dark gray (zinc) palette, never pure black (#000000).
Apply The 'Technical' Look: Use grid borders (border-r border-b border-zinc-800) for data-heavy sections instead of standalone floating cards.
Risk levels must be color-coded strictly: Critical=Red, High=Amber, Medium=Yellow, Low=Green. Use these colors for badges, chart elements, and progress bars.
Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric data (IP addresses, Risk Scores, Timestamps).
Do NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Implement real-time-feeling micro-animations (e.g., pulse on critical alerts, smooth width transitions on progress bars).
Use Recharts for all visual data. Customize axes to be subtle (zinc-800) and use custom tooltips matching the dark theme.
Create a modular SOC Dashboard layout using CSS Grid where widgets stretch to fill container heights.
Ensure the Sidebar Navigation is sticky and uses a distinct surface color (zinc-900) from the main content (zinc-950).
Ensure file extensions are .js (not .tsx) as per the project configuration.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but prefer elevation via lightness in dark mode.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded, not pill for this technical app) with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters. Use Lucide icons.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
